layouts.name: Bunny Loop
layouts.description: The narrow two-straight test loop east of the TRC Ohio high-speed oval is independently digitized from public-domain 2023 aerial imagery. The operator identifies the Ohio proving-ground site and its testing facilities; the catalogue name and timing location identify this specific loop. The small southern turnaround and northern crossing return are retained; the large high-speed oval and adjacent handling roads are excluded. Turnaround alignment and direction remain draft. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 2260.2 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
